question: In Slack: Invite the user whose post about the lattice outage in #outages drew two replies to #followups. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:

Its thread has **3** replies ("Ack.", "Looking at graphs.", "Paging the secondary."), and all three are marcus's own posts in the thread. So no post there drew exactly two replies, and I didn't invite anyone.

If you meant marcus.webb (UNNJDFRNWHF) despite the count, say the word and I'll add him to #followups.
